machine: MacBook Pro, Apple M5 Max, 36 GB

embeddings.test: 500 real reposts from the X feed: the cut-off "RT @x: …" text (first 110 characters) must find its full original among 5,500 posts. Speed on 3,000 real news headlines (CPU, 4 threads, re-timed in a clean process; Metal).
embeddings.vector_index: pgvector 0.8.0 is offered by our Supabase project and not switched on (pg_available_extensions). Switching it on is an additive change.

results.skipped: needs trust_remote_code (runs code from the model repo); not executed in this run

embeddings.note: gte-base and gte-modernbert were unexpectedly slow on CPU here (about 30 headlines a second, twice) although they are the same size as e5-base; on Metal they are fast. nomic-embed-text-v1.5 was not run: it needs trust_remote_code (it executes code from the model repository).

ticker_linking.test: the 100 hand-flagged news rows: 12 are filed under a ticker the story is not about (examples: TGT on "Target Generation", STX on a TJX story, HD on a Devon Energy story, KO on Coca-Cola Europacific Partners, DOW on the Dow Jones index).

results.method: ticker + company-name list (plain matching, no model)
GLiNER medium v2.1 (company / stock ticker / fund) -> name list

ticker_linking.note: Several "good rows wrongly rejected" are rows whose stored snippet never names the company (quote-list pages, "2 AI stocks" teasers, oil stories filed under USO), so the flag should mark a row for a lower weight, not delete it.

anomaly.test: 89 names, the last 250 daily moves each, daily closes from our chart service (read-only). "next_day_move_vs_normal" = the average size of the day after a flag, divided by the average day: above 1 means the flag marked a name that kept moving.
anomaly.what_the_rules_file_intends: data/scintilla-rules.json: 2x the usual day is "about one day in twenty" = 5% of days.

results.method: ours: |move| >= 2 x stdev of last 60 moves, and >= 1%
robust: |move - median| >= 3 x (1.4826 x MAD) over last 60, and >= 1%

hugging_face_searches.FinNER: 5 models, the most used has 269 downloads

fly.gpu: Not on offer. `fly platform vm-sizes` lists only shared-cpu-1x…8x and performance-1x…16x; fly.io/docs/gpus now redirects to the blog post "We Were Wrong About GPUs" (https://fly.io/blog/wrong-about-gpu/); the pricing page lists no GPU price.

cpu_prices_from_pricing_page.billing: by the second while running; a stopped machine costs 0.15 dollars per GB of disk per month

fly.not_measured: No Fly machine was started in this run: the only existing app that could host one copies the provider keys into the machine, and installing Python packages next to those keys is a risk not worth a timing number. Fly CPU speeds below are estimates from the Mac CPU timings (a Fly core taken as 2.5 to 4 times slower than an M5 Max core).
